name: plain-crlf
reason: CRLF moves to column zero on the next row; ordinary shell output.

name: progress-overwrite-and-erase
reason: A carriage return overwrites from column zero; EL clears the old suffix.

name: pending-wrap
reason: A last-column character defers wrapping until the next printable character.

name: erase-clears-pending-wrap
reason: EL clears pending wrap under xterm/Ghostty semantics; phosphor documents Alacritty as a deliberate difference here.

name: cursor-save-restore
reason: DECSC/DECRC restore the saved cursor after unrelated output.

name: wide-cjk
reason: A CJK ideograph takes two terminal columns.

name: combining-mark
reason: A combining acute accent adds no column to the preceding e.

name: alternate-screen-active
reason: Mode 1049 uses a separate screen while preserving the main one.

name: alternate-screen-return
reason: Leaving mode 1049 restores the main screen and saved cursor.

name: scroll-region
reason: LF at the bottom of a scrolling region scrolls only that region.

name: origin-mode
reason: With DECOM set, CUP row 1 is the top scrolling margin.

name: autowrap-disabled
reason: With DECAWM disabled, additional characters overwrite the last column.

name: insert-mode
reason: IRM inserts cells rather than overwriting the current one.

name: split-csi
reason: A CSI sequence can cross PTY read boundaries without becoming visible text.

name: split-osc
reason: An OSC title string and its split ST terminator are not screen text.

name: split-utf8
reason: A four-byte UTF-8 scalar split across reads remains one wide character.

name: main-screen-narrow-reflow
reason: Narrowing a soft-wrapped logical line reflows its cells without losing text.

name: main-screen-reflow-roundtrip
reason: Widening back reconstructs the same logical line and cursor.

name: grapheme-family-mode-2027
reason: Mode 2027: a family emoji ZWJ cluster occupies two columns. Derived from Ghostty's translated 'print multicodepoint grapheme, mode 2027' test; phosphor explicitly excludes it.

name: grapheme-family-split-writes
reason: Grapheme assembly must survive separate writes, not only one contiguous string.

name: grapheme-heart-vs16
reason: Mode 2027: VS16 widens a text heart to two columns; upstream Ghostty 'graphemeWidth parity' test expects width two.

name: grapheme-umbrella-vs15
reason: Mode 2027: VS15 narrows the umbrella to text presentation; upstream 'VS15 to make narrow character' expects width one.

name: grapheme-skin-tone
reason: Mode 2027: an emoji and skin-tone modifier form one two-column grapheme; upstream 'print skin tone' expects width two.

name: grapheme-vs16-wrap
reason: VS16 widening at the last column moves the grapheme to the next row; upstream 'VS16 to make wide character on next line'.

name: grapheme-overwrite
reason: Overwriting the head of a wide grapheme removes the entire old grapheme, as upstream 'overwrite multicodepoint grapheme clears grapheme data'.

name: grapheme-disabled-codepoint-widths
reason: Explicitly disabling mode 2027 preserves codepoint widths: three wide emoji plus X. This is a deliberate behavior control rather than a Unicode defect.
